info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Logistics Shipments Create-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Creation API enables businesses to efficiently initiate the shipment of goods through a streamlined process. This endpoint allows users to create new logistics shipment records, facilitating better management of shipping operations. Typical consumers include logistics coordinators and supply chain managers who need to dynamically manage their shipments. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational workflow and ensure timely deliveries.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new shipment in the system by providing the necessary shipment details. Ensure all required fields are included in the request body to successfully create a shipment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new shipment. It must include all necessary details such as sender and receiver information, shipment dimensions, weight, and any special handling requirements.

200.description: The shipment was created successfully and the details are returned.
